title: Remove Total Volume row from Monthly Volume Summary

requirements.text: Remove the entire “Total Volume” tile/row (label + value) from the Monthly Volume Summary section only, so that Monthly Volume Summary shows only Total Reps and/or Total Time when applicable and never renders a Total Volume item.

quotes: 2. Only in the monthly volume summary section

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/features/becoming/components/MonthlyVolumeSummary.tsx, the UI no longer renders the block with label “Total Volume”, regardless of whether numeric-volume habits exist.
Monthly Volume Summary continues to correctly render “Total Reps” when reps-based habits exist and “Total Time” when time-based habits exist.
No other part of the app (e.g., habit rows, edit modal, or any other summaries) is changed as part of this update.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui) must not be edited.
Do not change backend logic or Motoko state/schema for this UI-only removal.
nonGoals: Do not hide or remove numeric volume tracking elsewhere in the app.
Do not change how monthly totals are computed; only remove the display of the Total Volume item in Monthly Volume Summary.
